description: apply_discount() subtracts the fraction instead of scaling the price.

issue.title: Totals are wrong when a coupon is used
issue.body:
We offer a 25% discount coupon. A basket of items costing 100 in total shows a price of about
119.7 at checkout when the coupon is applied, but it should be 90. Without a coupon the totals
are right, so it only goes wrong with the discount.
